stagingExclusionsExample.note: All clicks used native Windows UI. Only fixture initialization used CLI; independent read-only Git/SQLite checks verified staging and saved rules. No demo remote, commit or worktree content change during GUI sequence.

fileHistoryExample.method: Native Windows captures of production UI and real Git services; screenshot launcher only isolates settings and pre-trusts the demo fixture. JPEG captures were decoded to PNG, cropped and numbered with the existing renderer; UI text and success states were not redrawn.
fileHistoryExample.captureFormat: JPEG from Computer Use; PNG public raw images preserve decoded pixels
